issue.body:
[PR #2261’s test job](https://github.com/max-sixty/leaf/actions/runs/38055782458) failed in `test_primary_arrival_records_a_return_place_only_when_travelling[False-True-1000]`: the shift watcher reported a thread preview and its editor moving without input during return travel. The PR only changes the data explorer’s table padding and its derived corpus, so this is a separate browser-test failure that currently prevents the verified page repair from receiving a green broad check.

The same test passed in a single local run, then `uv run leaf-dev flake 'tests/test_render_application_boundary.py::test_primary_arrival_records_a_return_place_only_when_travelling[False-True-1000]'` produced 4 passes, 13 shift-watch errors, and one final-scroll mismatch (`928` rather than `1000`) across 18 copies. The test calls `threadActions.open(..., {travel: true})` through `page.evaluate`, then calls browser Back while arrival is still moving. The evidence establishes a scheduling defect around that transition; it does not yet distinguish a missing input boundary in the test from a product return-position race. Changing either without settling that distinction risks hiding a user-visible movement or weakening the watch.

Investigate the transition with a held browser ordering, then fix the owner that loses the gesture or return position. The focused data explorer gate itself passes on #2261.
issue.title: ci-fix: history return races with thread preview movement
